style.styleTitle: Homcom 2ft Prelit Snow Flocked Tabletop Mini Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Light up your festive spirits with the HOMCOM Small Christmas Tree! Pre-lit with 35 warm white LEDs and a convenient timer, it offers a cosy glow with zero fuss. Adorned with snow-flocked branches and pine cones, it captures a winter wonderland vibe. Safety is paramount with flame-retardant branches, ready to brighten your space securely. Great for adding a touch of Christmas charm to any small indoor area!</p><ul><li>Prelit design with timer ensures easy, stress-free lighting;</li><li>64 snow-flocked tips and pine cones enhance a wintery festive atmosphere;</li><li>Flame-retardant branches allow safe placement even near fireplaces;</li><li>Round base wrapped in linen-look fabric combines stability with rustic charm;</li><li>Battery operation offers cordless convenience for placement anywhere;</li><li>Compact tabletop tree fits perfectly in small indoor spaces;</li><li>Colour: Green, White;</li><li>Light Colour: Warm White;</li><li>Material: Plastic, Metal, Linen;</li><li>Overall Dimension: F41 x 60H cm;</li><li>Base Diameter: F11 cm;</li><li>Tips Count: 64;</li><li>LED Light Count: 35;</li><li>Decoration Count: 6 (Pine Cone);</li><li>Suggest Shaping Time: 5 minutes;</li><li>Battery: 3 x AA Batteries (Not Included);</li><li>Item Label: 83C-141V00GN;</li></ul><p>NOTE: Only for indoor use, not for outdoor;</p>
